title: Knight Facing Dragon
description: A lone knight in shining armor and flowing red cape stands on a rocky cliff, sword raised towards a massive golden dragon looming in the misty sky above. The dragon has prominent horns and spines, with a hazy, smoky atmosphere and orange brushstroke accents filling the background.
